Mateus F-Droid repo

Personal, unofficial repo. Redistributes the upstream developer-signed Continuum APKs (AGPL-3.0), unmodified. Only this repo's index is signed by the repo maintainer; APK signatures stay the original developer's.

Currently it serves 1 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mateus2k2/fdroid/main/fdroid/repo

If you would like to manually verify the fingerprint (SHA-256) of the repository signing key, here it is:
